verdict.rationale: Brex evidences policy enforcement (policy field on bookings, out-of-policy flags), configurable approval flows, and an 'audit agent' that monitors and categorizes violations, but there is no documented immutable/exportable audit log of edits and approvals suitable for external audit review. Missing for 10: explicit audit-log/export feature, evidence of edit history retention, and independent confirmation the trail survives external audits.
